name: NGC 672 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 672, a barred spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc672-hubble
story: A symmetric barred spiral with well-defined arms, NGC 672 is locked in a gravitational dance with its neighbor IC 1727. Both galaxies show bursts of star formation at the same times, most likely stirred up each time the pair swings close.

claims.text: NGC 672 is a barred spiral galaxy with defined spiral arms
NGC 672 and IC 1727 are interacting galaxies
IC 1727 is interacting with its near neighbor NGC 672
Both galaxies had simultaneous bursts of star formation, most likely because the pair periodically approach each other and stir up gas and dust
The Hubble target NGC0672 was observed by program 12546, The Geometry and Kinematics of the Local Volume
